 Alex Brotherton
 Most recent Most popular 'To score a hat-trick is rally special' published at 22:24 GMT 22:24 GMT 
 FT: Arsenal 3-0 Benfica 
 Arsenal 
 Arsenal's hat-trick hero Alessia Russo, speaking to Uefa: "It feels really nice. I love playing in the Champions League and I love scoring goals. it was really good to get the win. To score a hat-trick is rally special.
 "We knew they were going to be tough. We were patient. It was a good night, lots of attacking football and really nice to get the win.
 We've had a tough time but on Saturday and then tonight it was about carrying on that form, building mor momentum. It's a long season, we've started not as we wanted to but it can be really exciting what this team has still got to offer. 
 We've got such a good squad. Anyone can step up and perform when they're needed. The squad is massive, we're in a good place and we are enjoying our football."
 On how it felt to wear the captain's armband: "It was really nice, an honour to captain this club."
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's incredible for Russo' published at 22:19 GMT 22:19 GMT 
 FT: Arsenal 3-0 Benfica 
 Arsenal 
 Arsenal's Caitlin Foord, speaking to U efa: "We know every game how important it is especially in this comptition. We are happy to be back here. We wanted to back up our win in the league and we are happy to get the win."
 On Alessia Russo's hat-trick: "It's incredible for Less, so happy for her. she's been pushing and pushing to get goals and to get three tonight I'm not surprised. I see her do it every day in training. We've got a nice connection and I love plying with her and feeding her the ball. I'm really happy for her."
 On Benfica: "The keeper made some great saves. We knew they were going to be a tough side. We knew we had to stick into it and win every battle. We hoped that we could grind them down and get some goals and we did that in the end, so job done."
 2 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22:15 GMT 22:15 GMT 
 FT: Arsenal 3-0 Benfica 
 Arsenal 
 Alessia Russo speaking to Disney+ about Arsenal building momentum after winning back-to-back games for the first time this season : "We said that the north London derby wouldn't have meant anything if we didn't go and back it up tonight so it was really important, back at Boreham Wood, use that as momentum and now hopefully we can build going forward.
 "You could see how many shots on target we had and that's something we've been really building, really focusing on. People feeling confident to step up and shoot from outside the box and their keeper made some great saves and maybe on another night it would have been even more. It was a really good performance."
 11 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22:13 GMT 22:13 GMT 
 FT: Arsenal 3-0 Benfica 
 Arsenal 
 Alessia Russo, who scored a hat-trick, speaking to Disney+ about the win and becoming the all-time leading English goal scorer in Women's Champions League history: "It feels really nice, obviously I love playing in the Champions League especially with Arsenal, what we're building. It feels really nice. I think the win was really important after building some momentum against Spurs and you can hear how loud it is at Boreham Wood, it's always nice to play here and it was a really big three points. 
 "You could hear a pin drop [during the penalty] they were on my side, that's why! They obviously know that we try and get in our zone for a penalty and then once we scored it was nice to celebrate with them."

 FULL-TIME published at 21:54 GMT 21:54 GMT 
 Arsenal 3-0 Benfica 
 It's three goals and three points for Arsenal, who now have back-to-back wins for the first time this season.
 Alessia Russo scored a hat-trick, becoming the all-time leading English goal scorer in Women's Champions League history.
 That's nine goals for Russo in her past seven games for club and country.
 Are Arsenal back?
